PockPock Agent 0.2.8 lets a stronger model plan your task in small checked steps, finds MCP servers and skills on mcpservers.org, makes OpenClaw lighter by offering each message only the skills that fit it, and fixes the Maintenance Manager so it never uses a cloud account you did not connect in PockPock.

## Download

| Your computer | Download |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) | [PockPock-Agent-Setup.exe](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-Setup.exe) |
| Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or newer) | [PockPock-Agent-mac-arm64.dmg](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-mac-arm64.dmg) |
| Mac with an Intel processor | [PockPock-Agent-mac-x64.dmg](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-mac-x64.dmg) |

**Already using 0.2.7 on Windows?** PockPock updates itself: press **Restart to update** when it appears, or check in **Settings → Updates**. On a Mac, download and install it once, the same way as the first time. Your chats, settings and models are kept.

**New to PockPock?** Open the downloaded file, then press **Set up PockPock**; setup installs everything else. Windows may show **"Windows protected your PC"** because PockPock is not code-signed yet: press **More info**, then **Run anyway**. On a Mac, see the [installation guide](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/wiki/Installation).

## What's new since 0.2.7

### Plan in steps (PockPock Agent)

- In PockPock Agent's model menu, the new **Planning** section lets a stronger model write the plan: **Plan in steps with** a connected cloud model (for example an NVIDIA NIM model) or a large local model. The model you already pick does the steps.
- The plan card shows each step and the check that must pass before the next step starts, who plans and who works, and a note when a cloud model receives your request.
- Each step runs with a short prompt and only the tools it needs, so small local models stay fast and on track. The run bar shows **Step 2 of 3**; a step that fails is tried again, and a step that still fails stops the run with **Retry from step N**.
- Changes to files in the folder you opened are shown for approval in Auto-review, as in normal runs.
- Tested on an RTX 4070 SUPER with `qwen3.6:35b-a3b` planning and `qwen3.5:9b` doing the steps: two tasks completed. Planning with NVIDIA NIM has not been tested with a real key yet.

### Find MCP servers and skills on mcpservers.org

- The **MCP servers** and **Skills** pages have a **Find on mcpservers.org** search. Curated servers come with a description and **Preview and install**, which shows exactly what would be installed before anything is; every result opens on mcpservers.org.
- **Search all servers on mcpservers.org** searches the whole site (about 13,000 servers; about 8,000 skills). It downloads the site's index once (about 57 MB for servers, 9 MB for skills) and refreshes it weekly. Your searches stay on your PC.
- When PockPock cannot tell how to start a server from its link, the result says why and what to do (open its page for the setup steps, then paste its command).

### OpenClaw

- **Lighter turns:** before each message, PockPock offers OpenClaw only the skills and MCP servers that fit it, and the task shows "Offered OpenClaw 2 of 22 skills". It only hides, never switches anything on, and offers everything when there is little to save or anything fails. Turn it off with `POCKPOCK_OPENCLAW_TOOL_RETRIEVAL=0`.
- **New models appear:** OpenClaw's model menu now follows the models installed in Ollama. A model pulled after OpenClaw was set up, such as `qwen3.6:35b-a3b`, appears, and removed ones disappear.

### Maintenance Manager: your account only when you connect it

- **PockPock itself** (a local model) is now the default Maintenance Manager. It fixes the problems you report on this PC, and nothing leaves it.
- Connecting your own **Claude**, **OpenAI (ChatGPT)** or **GitHub Copilot** account is optional, for people who want a stronger model to fix reports. A note on the page says so, and that it uses your plan and sends the report and the code it reads to that company.
- A tool that is only signed in on this PC — for example Claude Code signed in from your editor — is shown as **Not connected** and is not used until you press **Connect** here. Before this change it was treated as connected, so with automatic fixing on, report fixes could run on your Claude account without anyone connecting it in PockPock.
- If no account is connected, or the connected one stops working, PockPock itself takes over and the page says why.
- If a connected account fails before changing anything (signed out, usage limit, not installed), PockPock itself tries once, so the report still gets a fix.
- **Disconnect** stops using an account; the tool stays installed and signed in on this PC for other programs.
- OpenAI Codex can now be installed and signed in from PockPock, like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot.

### Agent Studio design boards

- The Agent Studio redesign is now a versioned design artifact in the repo: 21 boards under `design/agent-studio/v1/` (shell, run states, plan review, thread cards, pickers, files and terminal, dialogs, first-run setup, every Workshop page, Settings and Setup), plus `canvas.json`.
- This is a design proposal only. Nothing in `desktop/` changes, and none of it has been built or tested in the Electron app. All numbers, task titles, model sizes and connector names in the boards are sample content.

### Agent Studio in the docs

- The README now describes the Agent Studio window (icon rail, task list, run bar, Inspector, status bar) and the run bar, Inspector, notifications, **Retry from step N** and the other Agent Studio behaviour.
- `docs/features/desktop-app.md` now records **Agent Studio design coverage**: what of the 21 design boards is built and what is not, with the reason.
- The parts not built yet are tracked as TASKS UI-01G to UI-01M (Ready, not started): Activity charts, Terminal tabs, Services **Restart all** and per-service ports, Models **Unload** and purpose tags, Skills use counts, the last lines of a running command's output under its step, Research **View changes**, and Browser recipes showing the running step.
- The design-system doc now says **Workshop pages** instead of **Customize pages**.

### Fixes

- The Research page note no longer shows a double full stop ("…when enabled.. No API keys…").

## Good to know

- Every pull request in this release passed the full check suite (backend tests and desktop typecheck and build on Ubuntu, Windows and macOS).
- With a cloud planner, your request, the plan and each step's results (file names and short excerpts) go to that service; the plan card says so before you approve.
- Help, screenshots and example prompts are in the [wiki](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/wiki).
- Please [report problems](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/issues/new/choose).
